product_overview: NotebookLM is an AI notebook platform for educational institutions that lets users upload PDF/TXT documents, ingest and index them into a vector store, and ask grounded questions over selected sources. The system provides streamed chat responses with citations, tenant isolation, and development-mode JWT authentication.
core_goals: Enable secure document upload and ingestion for PDF and TXT files
Index uploaded documents for retrieval with usable chunking and vector search
Provide grounded chat answers with source citations via streaming SSE
Enforce tenant and source ownership isolation across users
Expose reliable health and status endpoints for operational readiness
Fail safely on invalid or unsupported uploads without server errors

features.name: Health Check
features.description: Provides a simple liveness endpoint for infrastructure and uptime monitoring.
user_flows: GET /health -> Receive 200 with service health status
GET /health during normal operation -> Receive 200 response indicating the service is healthy

features.name: Authentication and Tenant Isolation
features.description: Validates bearer JWTs in development and resolves tenant context from the localhost subdomain.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/ingest/sources with Authorization: Bearer <dev unsigned JWT with sub claim> -> Receive 200 with the authenticated user's sources for the resolved tenant
POST /api/v1/chat/stream without Authorization header -> Receive 401 unauthorized response
POST /api/v1/chat/stream with a token for one user but active_source_ids owned by another user -> Receive 403 source access denied

features.name: Document Ingestion
features.description: Allows users to upload PDF or TXT documents, track ingestion status, list sources, and delete sources with their vectors.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/ingest/upload with multipart file=standard_chapter.pdf and valid Authorization header -> Receive 200 SourceResponse -> GET /api/v1/ingest/sources -> Receive 200 with source status indexed and chunks_count > 0
POST /api/v1/ingest/upload with encrypted_sample.pdf and no pdf_password -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/v1/ingest/upload with encrypted_sample.pdf and pdf_password=testpass -> Receive 200 SourceResponse -> GET /api/v1/ingest/sources -> Receive 200 with source status indexed
POST /api/v1/ingest/upload with unsupported file type such as .exe or jpg_renamed.pdf -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/v1/ingest/upload with truncated.pdf or another corrupt file -> Receive 400 validation error and no 500 error
POST /api/v1/ingest/upload with blank_scanned.pdf -> Receive 200 SourceResponse -> GET /api/v1/ingest/sources -> Receive 200 with source status error and a clear image-only message
POST /api/v1/ingest/upload with two uploads of the same document -> Receive 200 for both uploads -> GET /api/v1/ingest/sources -> Receive 200 with two unique source IDs
DELETE /api/v1/ingest/sources/{source_id} for an owned source -> Receive 200 object confirming deletion -> GET /api/v1/ingest/sources -> Receive 200 and the source is no longer listed
DELETE /api/v1/ingest/sources/{source_id} for a missing source_id -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: RAG Chat Streaming
features.description: Streams grounded answers over Server-Sent Events using user-selected sources, with citations from retrieved chunks.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/chat/stream with message='What role does chlorophyll play?', empty history, and active_source_ids containing an indexed source -> Receive 200 text/event-stream with citation, chunk, and done events
POST /api/v1/chat/stream with a factual question that matches multiple documents -> Receive 200 text/event-stream with citations from multiple sources
POST /api/v1/chat/stream with an out-of-corpus question and valid active_source_ids -> Receive 200 text/event-stream with a refusal or 'not found' style answer and no hallucinated citation
POST /api/v1/chat/stream with active_source_ids empty -> Receive 400 no sources selected
POST /api/v1/chat/stream with active_source_ids referencing a source owned by another user -> Receive 403 source access denied
POST /api/v1/chat/stream with a long multi-sentence question and valid history -> Receive 200 text/event-stream with grounded answer and citations
